title: Inspect a simulated heap
description: You can follow integer addresses through allocation, lookup, and explicit release.

steps.description: Heap stores allocated records in memory and available integer addresses in free. The default capacity is 64 slots.
alloc removes the first free address and stores a typed record there. It raises MemoryError when no address remains.
get reads a record. free_addr removes a stored record and returns its address to the free list; live_count counts stored records.

steps.question: What address does b's cdr field hold after these allocations?
steps.answer: It holds a, the first allocated address, which is 0.

steps.description: The recording shows three allocated objects and b's cdr of 0. Explicitly freeing c leaves two stored objects.
